etymology: probably for an obsolete tucho (for which the middle voice of another alternate teucho [to make ready or bring to pass] is used in certain tenses, akin to the base of 5088 through the idea of effecting
avSummary: obtain 5, be 1, chance 1, little 1, enjoy 1, may be 1, not tr 1, misc 2
definition:
1) to hit the mark
    1a) of one discharging a javelin or arrow
 2) to reach, attain, obtain, get, become master of
 3) to happen, chance, fall out
    3a) to specify, to take a case, as for example
 4) to meet one
 5) of he who meets one or presents himself unsought, any chance,
    ordinary, common person
 6) to chance to be
